router.get('/audit/all',requireSuper,async(req,res)=>{
 const requested=Number(req.query.branch_id||0)
 if(requested && !validId(requested))return res.status(400).json({message:'Invalid branch.'})
 const page=Math.max(1,Math.min(100000,Number.parseInt(req.query.page,10)||1)),limit=Math.min(100,Math.max(10,Number.parseInt(req.query.limit,10)||25))
 const allowedActions=['create','update','delete','auth','branch','service','booking','account','appointment']
 const action=String(req.query.action||'').trim()
 if(action && !allowedActions.includes(action))return res.status(400).json({message:'Invalid activity filter.'})
 const search=String(req.query.search||'').trim().slice(0,100)
 const where=[],params=[]
 if(requested){where.push('a.branch_id=?');params.push(requested)}
 if(action){where.push('a.action LIKE ?');params.push(`%${action}%`)}
 if(search){where.push('(a.action LIKE ? OR a.entity_type LIKE ? OR a.entity_id LIKE ?)');params.push(...Array(3).fill(`%${search}%`))}
 const from=String(req.query.from||''),to=String(req.query.to||'')
 if(from||to){if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(from)||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(to)||from>to)return res.status(400).json({message:'Enter valid start and end dates.'});where.push('DATE(a.created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ?');params.push(from,to)}
 const sqlWhere=where.length?`WHERE ${where.join(' AND ')}`:''
 const [[count]]=await db.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM audit_logs a ${sqlWhere}`,params)
 const [rows]=await db.query(`SELECT a.*,b.name AS branch_name,CASE WHEN a.user_role IN ('admin','superadmin') THEN aa.full_name WHEN a.user_role='staff' THEN ss.full_name WHEN a.user_role='doctor' THEN dd.full_name WHEN a.user_role='patient' THEN pp.full_name ELSE NULL END AS actor_name FROM audit_logs a LEFT JOIN clinic_branches b ON b.id=a.branch_id LEFT JOIN admins aa ON a.user_role IN ('admin','superadmin') AND aa.id=a.user_id LEFT JOIN staff ss ON a.user_role='staff' AND ss.id=a.user_id LEFT JOIN doctors dd ON a.user_role='doctor' AND dd.id=a.user_id LEFT JOIN patients pp ON a.user_role='patient' AND pp.id=a.user_id ${sqlWhere} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`,[...params,limit,(page-1)*limit])
 // Keep the legacy array response only for legacy callers; new UI opts into pagination.
 if(req.query.paginated==='1')return res.json({rows,total:Number(count.total),page,limit,pages:Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Number(count.total)/limit))})
 res.json(rows)
})

// Compatibility responses for the ORIGINAL Admin Portal. Unlike the legacy
// /api/admin controllers, every query is scoped to an authenticated branch.
// Unsupported legacy mutations deliberately return 404 instead of falling
// through to an unscoped controller. Restore each workflow only after auditing it.
const bridgeDate = value => typeof value === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ? value : null
const originalDashboard = async(req,res) => {
  const id=req.branchId
  const [[pending]]=await db.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS pendingApprovals FROM appointments WHERE branch_id=? AND status='pending'`,[id])
  const [[patients]]=await db.query(`SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS totalPatients FROM appointments WHERE branch_id=?`,[id])
  const [[lowStock]]=await db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS lowStockCount FROM inventory WHERE branch_id=? AND stock<=threshold',[id])
  const [doctors]=await db.query(`SELECT d.id,d.full_name,d.clinic_type,CASE WHEN d.is_active=1 THEN 'available' ELSE 'inactive' END AS status FROM doctors d WHERE d.branch_id=? ORDER BY d.full_name`,[id])
  const {getOnlineBookingReadiness}=require('../utils/bookingReadiness')
  const bookingReadiness=await getOnlineBookingReadiness(db,id)
  res.json({pendingApprovals:Number(pending.pendingApprovals||0),totalPatients:Number(patients.totalPatients||0),lowStockCount:Number(lowStock.lowStockCount||0),doctorStatus:doctors,bookingReadiness})
}
const originalAppointments = async(req,res) => {
  const date=bridgeDate(req.query.date)
  if(req.query.date && !date)return res.status(400).json({message:'Invalid date.'})
  const [rows]=await db.query(`SELECT a.*,DATE_FORMAT(a.appointment_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS appointment_date,
    a.appointment_time AS time,a.clinic_type AS type,
    p.full_name AS patient_name,p.full_name AS patient_full_name,
    d.full_name AS doctor_name,d.full_name AS doctor,d.specialty
    FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id=a.patient_id
    JOIN doctors d ON d.id=a.doctor_id
    WHERE a.branch_id=? ${date?'AND a.appointment_date=?':''}
    ORDER BY a.appointment_date DESC,a.appointment_time ASC LIMIT 500`,date?[req.branchId,date]:[req.branchId])
  res.json(rows)
}
const originalPatients = async(req,res)=>{
  const [rows]=await db.query(`SELECT p.id,p.full_name,p.birthdate,p.gender,p.sex,p.civil_status,p.phone,p.address,p.email,p.created_at,p.profile_image_url,p.is_walk_in FROM patients p WHERE EXISTS
    (SELECT 1 FROM appointments a WHERE a.patient_id=p.id AND a.branch_id=?)
    ORDER BY p.full_name LIMIT 500`,[req.branchId]);res.json(rows)
}
const originalPatientDetails=async(req,res)=>{
  const patientId=Number(req.params.id)
  if(!validId(patientId))return res.status(400).json({message:'Invalid patient.'})
  const [[patient]]=await db.query(`SELECT p.id,p.full_name,p.birthdate,p.gender,p.sex,p.civil_status,p.phone,p.address,p.email,p.created_at,p.profile_image_url,p.is_walk_in FROM patients p WHERE p.id=? AND EXISTS
    (SELECT 1 FROM appointments a WHERE a.patient_id=p.id AND a.branch_id=?)`,[patientId,req.branchId])
  if(!patient)return res.status(404).json({message:'Patient not found in this branch.'})
  const [history]=await db.query(`SELECT a.*,DATE_FORMAT(a.appointment_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS appointment_date,
      d.full_name AS doctor_name,c.diagnosis,c.prescription,c.notes AS consultation_notes
      FROM appointments a JOIN doctors d ON d.id=a.doctor_id
      LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.appointment_id=a.id AND c.branch_id=a.branch_id
      WHERE a.patient_id=? AND a.branch_id=? ORDER BY a.appointment_date DESC LIMIT 500`,[patientId,req.branchId])
  res.json({patient,history})
}
const originalDoctors=async(req,res)=>{
  const [rows]=await db.query('SELECT id,full_name,full_name AS name,email,phone,specialty,clinic_type,clinic_type AS type,prc_license,is_active,created_at FROM doctors WHERE branch_id=? ORDER BY full_name',[req.branchId]);res.json(rows)
}
const originalStaff=async(req,res)=>{
  const [rows]=await db.query('SELECT id,full_name,email,phone,role,status,created_at FROM staff WHERE branch_id=? ORDER BY full_name',[req.branchId]);
  const [permissions]=await db.query(`SELECT sp.staff_id,sp.permission_key FROM staff_permissions sp JOIN staff s ON s.id=sp.staff_id WHERE s.branch_id=? AND sp.granted=1`,[req.branchId]);
  res.json(rows.map(row=>({...row,permissions:permissions.filter(p=>Number(p.staff_id)===Number(row.id)).map(p=>p.permission_key)})))
}
const originalDoctorSchedules=async(req,res)=>{
  const doctorId=Number(req.params.id)
  if(!validId(doctorId))return res.status(400).json({message:'Invalid doctor.'})
  const [[doctor]]=await db.query('SELECT id FROM doctors WHERE id=? AND branch_id=?',[doctorId,req.branchId])
  if(!doctor)return res.status(404).json({message:'Doctor not found in this branch.'})
  const [rows]=await db.query('SELECT * FROM doctor_schedules WHERE doctor_id=? ORDER BY day_of_week',[doctorId]);res.json(rows)
}
const originalServices=async(req,res)=>{
  const [rows]=await db.query(`SELECT * FROM billing_service_catalog WHERE branch_id=? ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 500`,[req.branchId]);res.json(rows)
}
const originalInventory=async(req,res)=>{
  const [rows]=await db.query('SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE branch_id=? ORDER BY name LIMIT 500',[req.branchId]);res.json(rows)
}

  router.get(`${prefix}/doctors/:id/schedules`,...middle,requirePermission('doctor_schedules'),originalDoctorSchedules)
  router.get(`${prefix}/staff`,...middle,requirePermission('accounts'),originalStaff)
  const validateDelegation=(req,res,next)=>{
    if(req.adminContext.account_role==='superadmin')return next()
    if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(req.body||{},'permissions'))return next()
    const allowed=new Set(req.adminPermissions)
    if(allowed.has('billing'))allowed.add('checkout')
    // Branch administrators cannot delegate global website management.
    if(!Array.isArray(req.body.permissions) || req.body.permissions.some(p=>p==='landing_page'||!allowed.has(p)))
      return res.status(403).json({message:'You cannot grant staff permissions beyond your assigned branch access.'})
    next()
  }
  const ownedPerson=(table,permission,controller)=>[...middle,requirePermission(permission),async(req,res,next)=>{
    const id=Number(req.params.id)
    if(!validId(id))return res.status(400).json({message:'Invalid account.'})
    const [[person]]=await db.query(`SELECT id FROM ${table} WHERE id=? AND branch_id=?`,[id,req.branchId])
    if(!person)return res.status(404).json({message:'Account not found in your branch.'})
    return Promise.resolve(controller(req,res)).catch(next)
  }]
  router.post(`${prefix}/staff`,...middle,requirePermission('accounts'),validateDelegation,(req,res,next)=>Promise.resolve(oldAdmin.createStaff(req,res)).catch(next))
  router.put(`${prefix}/staff/:id`,validateDelegation,...ownedPerson('staff','accounts',oldAdmin.updateStaff))
  router.patch(`${prefix}/staff/:id/toggle`,...ownedPerson('staff','accounts',oldAdmin.toggleStaff))
  router.post(`${prefix}/doctors`,...middle,requirePermission('accounts'),(req,res,next)=>Promise.resolve(oldAdmin.createDoctor(req,res)).catch(next))
  router.put(`${prefix}/doctors/:id`,...ownedPerson('doctors','accounts',oldAdmin.updateDoctor))
  router.patch(`${prefix}/doctors/:id/toggle`,...ownedPerson('doctors','accounts',oldAdmin.toggleDoctor))
  router.put(`${prefix}/doctors/:id/schedules`,...ownedPerson('doctors','doctor_schedules',oldAdmin.saveDaySchedule))
  router.get(`${prefix}/doctors/:id/unavailable-dates`,...ownedPerson('doctors','doctor_schedules',oldAdmin.getDoctorUnavailableDatesAdmin))
  router.get(`${prefix}/doctors/:id/available-slots`,...ownedPerson('doctors','doctor_schedules',oldAdmin.getAppointmentAvailableSlotsAdmin))
  router.put(`${prefix}/doctors/:id/unavailable-dates`,...ownedPerson('doctors','doctor_schedules',oldAdmin.saveDoctorUnavailableDateAdmin))
  router.delete(`${prefix}/doctors/:id/unavailable-dates/:date`,...ownedPerson('doctors','doctor_schedules',oldAdmin.deleteDoctorUnavailableDateAdmin))
  router.get(`${prefix}/appointment-reasons`,...middle,requirePermission('appointments'),async(req,res)=>{
    const [rows]=await db.query(`SELECT id,label,clinic_type,is_active,created_at FROM appointment_reason_options WHERE branch_id=? ORDER BY label`,[req.branchId]);res.json(rows)
  })
  router.get(`${prefix}/appointment-cancellation-reasons`,...middle,requirePermission('appointments'),async(req,res)=>{
    const [rows]=await db.query(`SELECT id,label,is_active,created_at FROM appointment_cancellation_reasons WHERE branch_id=? ORDER BY created_at,id`,[req.branchId]);res.json(rows)
  })

  router.get(`${prefix}/billing/catalog`,...middle,allowAnyPermission('system_setup','appointments','billing'),originalServices)
  router.get(`${prefix}/inventory`,...middle,allowAnyPermission('inventory','billing'),originalInventory)
  router.get(`${prefix}/system-setup/booking-policy`,...middle,requirePermission('system_setup'),getBookingPolicy)
  router.put(`${prefix}/system-setup/booking-policy`,...middle,requirePermission('system_setup'),saveBookingPolicy)
  // Existing appointment transitions retain their original payload and status codes.
  for(const [action,controller] of Object.entries({confirm:oldAdmin.confirmAppointment,cancel:oldAdmin.cancelAppointment,'no-show':oldAdmin.markAppointmentNoShow,reschedule:oldAdmin.rescheduleAppointment})){
   router.patch(`${prefix}/appointments/:appointmentId/${action}`,...middle,...ownedAppointmentAction(controller))
  }
}

  login, checkAuth, logout,

// Backward-compatible finalization endpoint for older clients.

========================================================================================

'use strict'
const express = require('express')
const db = require('../db/connect')
const { createQr, retrieveIntent, retrieveRefund, credentials, fail } = require('../utils/paymongoClient')
const { assertVerifiedQrRefund } = require('../utils/paymongoRefundVerification')
const { verifyPaymongoSignature } = require('../utils/paymongoWebhookSignature')
const { getBillingRecordWithItems } = require('../utils/billing')
const { writeAuditLog } = require('../utils/audit')
const staffCtrl = require('../controllers/staff.controller')
const { broadcast } = require('../utils/sse')

const apiRouter = express.Router()
const knownStatus = new Set(['creating','pending','succeeded','failed','expired','review','refunded'])
const http = (code, message, status = 409) => Object.assign(new Error(message), {statusCode: status, code})
const validId = id => Number.isSafeInteger(Number(id)) && Number(id) > 0
const isTestSimulationUrl = url => {
  try { const parsed = new URL(url); return parsed.protocol === 'https:' && (parsed.hostname === 'paymongo.com' || parsed.hostname.endsWith('.paymongo.com')) }
  catch { return false }
}
const publicAttempt = row => ({
  id: Number(row.id), billing_id:Number(row.billing_id), branch_id: Number(row.branch_id),
  mode: 'test', status: row.status, amount: Number(row.amount_centavos)/100,
  expires_at: row.expires_at, qr_image: row.status === 'pending' ? row.qr_image : null,
  test_url: row.status === 'pending' && isTestSimulationUrl(row.test_url) ? row.test_url : null,
  error_code: row.error_code || null,
})
const getLatest = async (billId, branchId) => {
  const [[row]] = await db.query('SELECT * FROM payment_gateway_attempts WHERE billing_id=? AND branch_id=? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1', [billId,branchId])
  return row || null
}

const makeQr = async (req, res) => {
  credentials() // fail closed until valid test keys supplied; never create live payment
  if (!String(process.env.PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET || '').startsWith('whsk_')) throw http('PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_NOT_CONFIGURED','Configure the PayMongo test webhook signing secret before generating QR payments.',503)
  const billId = Number(req.params.id), branchId = Number(req.branchId)
  if (!validId(billId) || !validId(branchId)) throw http('BRANCH_REQUIRED','Valid branch and bill are required.',400)
  // An expired or never-issued QR must not hold the bill forever: settle or
  // release it against PayMongo before deciding whether a new QR is allowed.
  const [[stale]] = await db.query('SELECT a.id FROM payment_gateway_attempts a JOIN billing_records b ON b.id=a.billing_id WHERE a.active_bill_id=? AND b.branch_id=? LIMIT 1',[billId,branchId])
  if (stale) await reconcileAttempt(stale.id,{force:true}).catch(error=>console.warn('[paymongo-reconciliation] pre-QR check failed',{attemptId:stale.id,code:error.code}))
  const conn = await db.getConnection()
  let attempt
  try {
    await conn.query('SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED')
    await conn.beginTransaction()
    const [[locked]] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM billing_records WHERE id=? AND branch_id=? LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE', [billId,branchId])
    if (!locked) throw http('BILL_NOT_FOUND','Bill not found in this clinic branch.',404)
    const [[needsReview]] = await conn.query("SELECT id FROM payment_gateway_attempts WHERE billing_id=? AND status='review' AND provider_payment_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1",[billId])
    if (needsReview) throw http('GATEWAY_PAYMENT_NEEDS_REVIEW','A PayMongo payment for this bill is awaiting administrator review. Resolve it before generating another QR.')
    if (!['ready','partially_paid'].includes(locked.status)) throw http('BILL_NOT_READY','Confirm the bill before generating its QR.')
    const bill = await getBillingRecordWithItems(billId, conn)
    const amountCentavos = Math.round(Number(bill.balance_amount)*100)
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(amountCentavos) || amountCentavos < 100) throw http('INVALID_QR_AMOUNT','The remaining balance must be at least ₱1.00.')
    const [[existing]] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM payment_gateway_attempts WHERE active_bill_id=? LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE', [billId])
    if (existing) {
      await conn.commit()
      return res.json(publicAttempt(existing))
    }
    const [created] = await conn.query(`INSERT INTO payment_gateway_attempts
      (billing_id,branch_id,bill_version,amount_centavos,active_bill_id,created_by_role,created_by_id)
      VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`,[billId,branchId,locked.version,amountCentavos,billId,req.adminContext?.account_role==='superadmin'?'superadmin':req.user.role,req.user.id])
    attempt = { id: created.insertId, amountCentavos }
    await conn.commit()
  } catch (error) { await conn.rollback().catch(()=>{}); throw error }
  finally { conn.release() }
  try {
    const qr = await createQr({amountCentavos:attempt.amountCentavos,billId,attemptId:attempt.id,
      onIntentCreated: intentId => db.query('UPDATE payment_gateway_attempts SET payment_intent_id=? WHERE id=? AND payment_intent_id IS NULL',[intentId,attempt.id]) })
    await db.query(`UPDATE payment_gateway_attempts SET status='pending',payment_intent_id=?,qr_image=?,test_url=?,expires_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) WHERE id=? AND status='creating'`,
      [qr.intentId,qr.qrImage,isTestSimulationUrl(qr.testUrl)?qr.testUrl:null,attempt.id])
    const [[saved]] = await db.query('SELECT * FROM payment_gateway_attempts WHERE id=?',[attempt.id])
    return res.status(201).json(publicAttempt(saved))
  } catch (error) {
    // Network errors are indeterminate: hold the attempt for reconciliation rather
    // than allowing a second QR that could charge the patient twice.
    await db.query("UPDATE payment_gateway_attempts SET status='review',error_code=? WHERE id=? AND status='creating'",[String(error.code || 'PAYMONGO_UNKNOWN').slice(0,60),attempt.id]).catch(()=>{})
    throw error
  }
}
const status = async (req,res) => {
  const billId = Number(req.params.id), branchId = Number(req.branchId)
  if (!validId(billId) || !validId(branchId)) throw http('INVALID_BILL','Invalid bill.',400)
  const [[owned]] = await db.query('SELECT id FROM billing_records WHERE id=? AND branch_id=? LIMIT 1',[billId,branchId])
  if (!owned) throw http('BILL_NOT_FOUND','Bill not found in this branch.',404)
  let attempt = await getLatest(billId,branchId)
  if (attempt && ACTIVE.has(attempt.status) && !attempt.provider_payment_id) {
    attempt = await reconcileAttempt(attempt.id,{force:req.query.reconcile==='1'})
      .catch(error=>{console.warn('[paymongo-reconciliation] status check failed',{attemptId:attempt.id,code:error.code});return attempt}) || attempt
  }
  res.json(attempt ? publicAttempt(attempt) : {status:'not_created'})
}
// Administrator-only resolution for a provider payment that could not be applied
// (for example the patient paid an old QR after the bill was settled in cash).
// 'apply' retries settlement when the balance now allows it; 'refunded' records
// that the refund was completed in the PayMongo dashboard. Neither moves money.
const resolveReview = async (req,res) => {
  const isAdmin = req.adminContext && ['admin','superadmin'].includes(req.adminContext.account_role)
  if (!isAdmin) throw http('ADMIN_REQUIRED','Only an administrator can resolve a reviewed PayMongo payment.',403)
  const billId = Number(req.params.id), attemptId = Number(req.params.attemptId), branchId = Number(req.branchId)
  const action = String(req.body?.action||''), note = String(req.body?.note||'').trim().slice(0,500)
  const refundId = String(req.body?.refund_id || '').trim()
  if (!validId(billId) || !validId(attemptId) || !validId(branchId)) throw http('INVALID_BILL','Invalid bill.',400)
  if (!['apply','refunded'].includes(action)) throw http('INVALID_ACTION','Choose apply or refunded.',400)
  if (action==='refunded' && (note.length < 5 || !/^ref_[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{4,115}$/.test(refundId))) throw http('REFUND_PROOF_REQUIRED','Enter the verified PayMongo refund ID (ref_...) and an explanation.',400)
  const [[attempt]] = await db.query("SELECT * FROM payment_gateway_attempts WHERE id=? AND billing_id=? AND branch_id=? AND status='review' AND provider_payment_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1",[attemptId,billId,branchId])
  if (!attempt) throw http('REVIEW_NOT_FOUND','No PayMongo payment awaiting review for this bill.',404)
  let result
  if (action==='apply') {
    const intent = await retrieveIntent(attempt.payment_intent_id)
    const payment = (intent.attributes?.payments||[]).find(p=>p?.id===attempt.provider_payment_id)
    if (intent.attributes?.status!=='succeeded' || !payment) throw http('PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED','The PayMongo intent is not confirmed as paid.',409)
    result = await settleVerifiedPayment({...attempt,status:'pending'},payment,{fromReview:true})
    if (result.review) throw http('PAYMENT_STILL_NOT_APPLICABLE','The payment still cannot be applied to this bill. Refund it in PayMongo, then mark it refunded.',409)
  } else {
    // This is a provider-status CHECK, never an API refund request. The refund
    // must already have succeeded in PayMongo before local reconciliation.
    assertVerifiedQrRefund(await retrieveRefund(refundId), attempt)
    const [updated] = await db.query("UPDATE payment_gateway_attempts SET status='refunded',active_bill_id=NULL,error_code='REFUNDED_VERIFIED' WHERE id=? AND branch_id=? AND status='review' AND provider_payment_id=?",[attempt.id,branchId,attempt.provider_payment_id])
    if (updated.affectedRows !== 1) throw http('REVIEW_CHANGED','The reviewed payment has changed; reload before trying again.',409)
    result = {resolved:'refunded',provider_refund_id:refundId}
  }
  await writeAuditLog({userId:req.user.id,userRole:req.adminContext.account_role,action:`billing.gateway_review_${action}`,entityType:'billing_record',entityId:billId,
    oldValues:{attempt_id:attempt.id,error_code:attempt.error_code},newValues:{provider_payment_id:attempt.provider_payment_id,provider_refund_id:action==='refunded'?refundId:null,note},ipAddress:req.ip||null,branchId}).catch(()=>{})
  res.json({...result,attempt:publicAttempt((await db.query('SELECT * FROM payment_gateway_attempts WHERE id=?',[attempt.id]))[0][0])})
}
apiRouter.post('/:id/qr-payment', (req,res,next)=>Promise.resolve(makeQr(req,res)).catch(next))
apiRouter.get('/:id/qr-payment/status', (req,res,next)=>Promise.resolve(status(req,res)).catch(next))
apiRouter.post('/:id/qr-payment/:attemptId/resolve', (req,res,next)=>Promise.resolve(resolveReview(req,res)).catch(next))

// Called ONLY after signature, test-mode, intent and amount verification.
// Reuse CARAIT's existing single-payment transaction for receipt allocation and
// per-batch dispensing, with a backend-only verified provider context.
async function settleThroughExistingCheckout(attempt,payment) {
  const payId = String(payment.id)
  const req = {
    user: { role:'staff', id:null }, branchId: Number(attempt.branch_id),
    params:{id: String(attempt.billing_id)}, ip:null,
    gatewayVerified: { provider:'paymongo', intentId:attempt.payment_intent_id, paymentId:payId },
    body:{ payment_method:'qrph', payment_amount:Number(attempt.amount_centavos)/100,
      reference_number:payId, idempotency_key:`paymongo:${payId}`, payment_notes:'Verified PayMongo QR Ph test payment' },
  }
  let outcome = null, code = 200
  const res = { status(value){code=value;return this}, json(value){outcome=value;return this} }
  await staffCtrl.payBill(req,res)
  if (code >= 400 || !outcome) throw http('PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED', outcome?.message || 'Provider payment could not be reconciled to the bill.',409)
  const [[recorded]] = await db.query('SELECT id FROM billing_payments WHERE billing_id=? AND idempotency_key=? LIMIT 1',[attempt.billing_id,`paymongo:${payId}`])
  if (!recorded) throw http('PAYMENT_RECORD_MISSING','Provider payment did not create a local receipt.',503)
  return recorded.id
}
async function handleWebhookEvent(event) {
  const eid = String(event?.data?.id || '')
  const attrs = event?.data?.attributes
  const type = String(attrs?.type || '')
  if (!/^evt_[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{4,115}$/.test(eid) || attrs?.livemode !== false) throw http('INVALID_PAYMONGO_EVENT','Invalid test payment event.',400)
  if (!['payment.paid','payment.failed','qrph.expired'].includes(type)) return {ignored:true}
  const payment = attrs.data
  const paymentAttrs = payment?.attributes || {}
  const intentId = String(paymentAttrs.payment_intent_id || '')
  if (!intentId) return {ignored:true}
  const [[attempt]] = await db.query('SELECT * FROM payment_gateway_attempts WHERE payment_intent_id=? LIMIT 1',[intentId])
  if (!attempt) return {ignored:true}
  await db.query(`INSERT IGNORE INTO payment_gateway_webhook_events (event_id,attempt_id,event_type) VALUES (?,?,?)`,[eid,attempt.id,type])
  const [[savedEvent]] = await db.query('SELECT status FROM payment_gateway_webhook_events WHERE event_id=?',[eid])
  if (savedEvent?.status === 'processed') return {duplicate:true}
  if (type !== 'payment.paid') {
    // Failure/expiry must not override a succeeded payment. A failed method can
    // have another attempt pending; do not assume the whole intent is terminal.
    if (type === 'qrph.expired') await db.query("UPDATE payment_gateway_attempts SET status='expired',active_bill_id=NULL WHERE id=? AND status='pending'",[attempt.id])
    await db.query("UPDATE payment_gateway_webhook_events SET status='processed',processed_at=NOW() WHERE event_id=?",[eid])
    return {processed:true}
  }
  if (paymentAttrs.livemode !== false || paymentAttrs.status !== 'paid'
      || String(paymentAttrs.currency).toUpperCase() !== 'PHP'
      || String(paymentAttrs.source?.type || '').toLowerCase() !== 'qrph'
      || Number(paymentAttrs.amount) !== Number(attempt.amount_centavos)
      || !String(payment.id || '').startsWith('pay_')) throw http('PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH','Provider payment details do not match the original QR amount.')
  // Do not trust a signed fixture/event alone; independently retrieve the intent.
  const intent = await retrieveIntent(intentId)
  if (intent.id !== intentId || intent.attributes?.livemode !== false || intent.attributes?.status !== 'succeeded'
      || Number(intent.attributes?.amount) !== Number(attempt.amount_centavos)
      || String(intent.attributes?.currency).toUpperCase() !== 'PHP') throw http('PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED','The PayMongo intent is not confirmed as paid.',409)
  const outcome = await settleVerifiedPayment(attempt,payment)
  if (outcome.review) await db.query("UPDATE payment_gateway_webhook_events SET error_code=? WHERE event_id=?",[outcome.error_code,eid])
  await db.query("UPDATE payment_gateway_webhook_events SET status='processed',processed_at=NOW() WHERE event_id=?",[eid])
  return outcome.review ? {processed:true,review:true} : {processed:true}
}
// Shared by the webhook, status-poll reconciliation and the background sweeper.
// The caller has already verified the PayMongo intent is succeeded for this amount.
async function settleVerifiedPayment(attempt,payment) {
  const a = payment?.attributes || {}
  if (a.livemode !== false || a.status !== 'paid' || String(a.currency).toUpperCase() !== 'PHP'
      || String(a.source?.type || '').toLowerCase() !== 'qrph' || Number(a.amount) !== Number(attempt.amount_centavos)
      || !String(payment.id || '').startsWith('pay_')) throw http('PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH','Provider payment details do not match the original QR amount.')
  let receiptId
  if (attempt.status === 'succeeded') {
    const [[old]] = await db.query('SELECT id FROM billing_payments WHERE billing_id=? AND idempotency_key=? LIMIT 1',[attempt.billing_id,`paymongo:${payment.id}`])
    if (!old) throw http('PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED','Missing receipt for previously settled gateway attempt.')
    receiptId = old.id
  } else {
    try { receiptId = await settleThroughExistingCheckout(attempt,payment) }
    catch (error) {
      if (error.code !== 'PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED') throw error // database/transient: let PayMongo retry
      return markPaidForReview(attempt,payment,error)
    }
  }
  await db.query(`UPDATE payment_gateway_attempts SET status='succeeded',active_bill_id=NULL,
    qr_image=NULL,provider_payment_id=?,settled_payment_id=?,error_code=NULL WHERE id=? AND (provider_payment_id IS NULL OR provider_payment_id=?)`,[payment.id,receiptId,attempt.id,payment.id])
  broadcast(['admin','staff'],'billing_paid',{billingId:attempt.billing_id,provider:'paymongo'},{branchId:attempt.branch_id})
  return {processed:true,receiptId}
}
// The patient's money was confirmed by PayMongo but the bill can no longer accept
// it. Keep the provider payment durably (so it is never lost) and stop retries.
async function markPaidForReview(attempt,payment,cause) {
  const [[bill]] = await db.query('SELECT status FROM billing_records WHERE id=?',[attempt.billing_id])
  const errorCode = ['paid','voided','refunded'].includes(bill?.status) ? 'PAID_AFTER_SETTLEMENT' : 'PAID_NOT_APPLIED'
  await db.query("UPDATE payment_gateway_attempts SET status='review',provider_payment_id=?,error_code=? WHERE id=? AND status<>'succeeded'",[payment.id,errorCode,attempt.id])
  await writeAuditLog({userId:null,userRole:'system',action:'billing.gateway_payment_needs_review',entityType:'billing_record',entityId:attempt.billing_id,
    oldValues:{bill_status:bill?.status||null},newValues:{attempt_id:attempt.id,provider_payment_id:payment.id,amount:Number(attempt.amount_centavos)/100,error_code:errorCode,reason:String(cause?.message||'').slice(0,200)},
    ipAddress:null,branchId:attempt.branch_id}).catch(()=>{})
  console.error('[paymongo-reconciliation] provider payment needs review',{attemptId:attempt.id,billingId:attempt.billing_id,errorCode})
  broadcast(['admin','staff'],'billing_gateway_review',{billingId:attempt.billing_id,errorCode},{branchId:attempt.branch_id})
  return {review:true,error_code:errorCode}
}
const ACTIVE = new Set(['pending','creating','review'])
const UNISSUED_RELEASE_SECONDS = 120
const lastChecked = new Map()
// Bring one local attempt in line with PayMongo. Never marks anything paid
// without a provider-confirmed succeeded intent and a matching paid payment.
async function reconcileAttempt(attemptId,{force=false}={}) {
  const load = async () => (await db.query(`SELECT a.*, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,a.created_at,NOW()) AS age_seconds,
    (a.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND a.expires_at < NOW()) AS is_expired FROM payment_gateway_attempts a WHERE a.id=?`,[attemptId]))[0][0]
  const attempt = await load()
  if (!attempt || !ACTIVE.has(attempt.status) || attempt.provider_payment_id) return attempt
  const now = Date.now()
  if (now - (lastChecked.get(attempt.id)||0) < (force ? 2000 : 15000)) return attempt
  lastChecked.set(attempt.id,now)
  if (attempt.payment_intent_id) {
    const intent = await retrieveIntent(attempt.payment_intent_id)
    if (intent.id !== attempt.payment_intent_id || intent.attributes?.livemode !== false
        || Number(intent.attributes?.amount) !== Number(attempt.amount_centavos)) throw http('PAYMENT_INTENT_MISMATCH','PayMongo intent does not match this QR attempt.')
    const providerStatus = intent.attributes?.status
    if (providerStatus === 'succeeded') {
      const payment = (intent.attributes?.payments||[]).find(p=>p?.attributes?.status==='paid')
      if (payment) await settleVerifiedPayment(attempt,payment)
      return load()
    }
    if (providerStatus === 'processing') return attempt
  }
  // Only a QR that was actually shown (status pending) can be scanned. It is
  // released once past its expiry; an attempt that never produced a QR is
  // released after a grace period that exceeds every PayMongo request timeout.
  if (attempt.status === 'pending' && Number(attempt.is_expired)) {
    await db.query("UPDATE payment_gateway_attempts SET status='expired',active_bill_id=NULL,qr_image=NULL WHERE id=? AND status='pending' AND provider_payment_id IS NULL",[attempt.id])
  } else if (attempt.status !== 'pending' && Number(attempt.age_seconds) >= UNISSUED_RELEASE_SECONDS) {
    await db.query("UPDATE payment_gateway_attempts SET status='failed',active_bill_id=NULL,error_code=COALESCE(error_code,'QR_NOT_ISSUED') WHERE id=? AND status IN ('creating','review') AND provider_payment_id IS NULL",[attempt.id])
  }
  return load()
}
// Recovers payments whose webhook never arrived (ngrok outage, browser closed).
let sweeper = null
function startReconciliationSweeper(intervalMs = 60000) {
  if (sweeper || process.env.PAYMONGO_MODE !== 'test') return sweeper
  sweeper = setInterval(async () => {
    try {
      const [rows] = await db.query(`SELECT id FROM payment_gateway_attempts WHERE status IN ('pending','creating','review')
        AND provider_payment_id IS NULL AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE ORDER BY id LIMIT 25`)
      for (const row of rows) await reconcileAttempt(row.id).catch(error=>console.warn('[paymongo-reconciliation] sweep',{attemptId:row.id,code:error.code}))
    } catch (error) { console.warn('[paymongo-reconciliation] sweep failed',{code:error.code}) }
  }, intervalMs)
  sweeper.unref?.()
  return sweeper
}
const rawWebhook = async (req,res) => {
  if (process.env.PAYMONGO_MODE !== 'test' || !String(process.env.PAYMONGO_SECRET_KEY||'').startsWith('sk_test_')) return res.status(503).json({code:'PAYMONGO_DISABLED'})
  if (!verifyPaymongoSignature(req.body,req.get('paymongo-signature'),process.env.PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET)) return res.status(401).json({code:'INVALID_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE'})
  let event
  try { event=JSON.parse(req.body.toString('utf8')) }
  catch {return res.status(400).json({code:'INVALID_JSON'})}
  try {return res.json(await handleWebhookEvent(event))}
  catch (error) {
    console.error('[paymongo-reconciliation]',{code:error.code,message:error.message,eventId:event?.data?.id})
    return res.status(error.statusCode || 503).json({code:error.code||'RETRY_LATER'})
  }
}

// server/routers/queue.router.js
// Waiting-room display API. The route is reachable without a staff/admin session,
// but queue data is protected by a dedicated short-lived display session.

const crypto = require('crypto')
const express = require('express')
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken')
const router = express.Router()
const db = require('../db/connect')
const { queueDisplayLimiter } = require('../middlewares/rateLimit.middleware')
const { getTodayDateOnly, isClinicOpenDate } = require('../utils/date')

const COOKIE_NAME = 'queue_display_token'
const DISPLAY_ROLE = 'queue_display'
const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000

const safeEqual = (left, right) => {
  const a = Buffer.from(String(left || ''))
  const b = Buffer.from(String(right || ''))
  return a.length === b.length && crypto.timingSafeEqual(a, b)
}

const getDisplayPin = () => {
  const configured = String(process.env.QUEUE_DISPLAY_PIN || '').trim()
  if (configured) return configured
  // Local-only fallback keeps development usable, while production validation
  // requires an explicit non-default PIN.
  return process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? '' : '123456'
}

const getDisplayTtlMs = () => {
  const hours = Number(process.env.QUEUE_DISPLAY_SESSION_HOURS || 12)
  if (!Number.isFinite(hours) || hours <= 0) return DEFAULT_TTL_MS
  return Math.min(hours, 24) * 60 * 60 * 1000
}

const issueDisplaySession = (res, branch) => {
  const ttlMs = getDisplayTtlMs()
  const token = jwt.sign(
    { role: DISPLAY_ROLE, purpose: 'waiting_room_queue', branch_id: Number(branch.id), branch_name: branch.name },
    process.env.JWT_SECRET,
    { expiresIn: Math.floor(ttlMs / 1000) }
  )
  res.cookie(COOKIE_NAME, token, {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'Lax',
    path: '/api/queue',
    maxAge: ttlMs,
  })
}

const requireDisplaySession = (req, res, next) => {
  const token = req.cookies?.[COOKIE_NAME]
  if (!token) {
    return res.status(401).json({ code: 'QUEUE_DISPLAY_LOCKED', message: 'Queue display is locked.' })
  }
  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET)
    if (decoded.role !== DISPLAY_ROLE || decoded.purpose !== 'waiting_room_queue' || !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(decoded.branch_id)) || Number(decoded.branch_id) <= 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid display session.')
    }
    req.queueDisplay = decoded
    return next()
  } catch {
    res.clearCookie(COOKIE_NAME, { path: '/api/queue' })
    return res.status(401).json({ code: 'QUEUE_DISPLAY_LOCKED', message: 'Queue display session expired. Enter the display PIN again.' })
  }
}

// Branches are public clinic locations, but queue details require a PIN-bound session.
router.get('/display/branches', async (req, res) => {
  const [rows] = await db.query('SELECT id, name FROM clinic_branches WHERE is_active=1 ORDER BY name, id')
  res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
  res.json(rows)
})

router.post('/display/unlock', queueDisplayLimiter, async (req, res) => {
  const expectedPin = getDisplayPin()
  if (!expectedPin) {
    return res.status(503).json({ code: 'QUEUE_DISPLAY_NOT_CONFIGURED', message: 'Queue display PIN is not configured.' })
  }
  if (!safeEqual(req.body?.pin, expectedPin)) {
    return res.status(401).json({ code: 'INVALID_QUEUE_DISPLAY_PIN', message: 'Incorrect display PIN.' })
  }
  const branchId = Number(req.body?.branch_id)
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(branchId) || branchId <= 0) return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Choose a clinic branch.' })
  const [[branch]] = await db.query('SELECT id,name FROM clinic_branches WHERE id=? AND is_active=1 LIMIT 1', [branchId])
  if (!branch) return res.status(404).json({ code: 'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND', message: 'The selected clinic branch is unavailable.' })
  issueDisplaySession(res, branch)
  return res.json({ message: 'Queue display unlocked.', branch_name: branch.name })
})

router.post('/display/lock', (req, res) => {
  res.clearCookie(COOKIE_NAME, { path: '/api/queue' })
  res.json({ message: 'Queue display locked.' })
})

router.get('/live', requireDisplaySession, async (req, res) => {
  const branchId = Number(req.queueDisplay.branch_id)
  const [[branch]] = await db.query('SELECT id,name FROM clinic_branches WHERE id=? AND is_active=1 LIMIT 1', [branchId])
  if (!branch) return res.status(403).json({ code: 'BRANCH_INACTIVE', message: 'This clinic branch is no longer available. Choose another branch.' })
  const today = getTodayDateOnly()

  // Public-facing data intentionally excludes patient names and contact details.
  const [servingRows] = await db.query(
    `SELECT q.queue_number AS queueNo,
            q.type,
            d.full_name AS doctor,
            TIME_FORMAT(q.called_at, '%h:%i %p') AS calledAt,
            TIME_FORMAT(q.arrived_at, '%h:%i %p') AS arrivedAt
     FROM queue q
     JOIN doctors d ON q.doctor_id = d.id
     WHERE q.branch_id = ? AND d.branch_id = q.branch_id AND q.queue_date = ? AND q.status = 'called'
     ORDER BY q.queue_number ASC
     LIMIT 1`,
    [branchId, today]
  )

  const [waitingRows] = await db.query(
    `SELECT q.queue_number AS queueNo,
            q.type,
            TIME_FORMAT(q.arrived_at, '%h:%i %p') AS arrivedAt
     FROM queue q
     WHERE q.branch_id = ? AND q.queue_date = ? AND q.status = 'waiting'
     ORDER BY q.queue_number ASC`,
    [branchId, today]
  )

  const clinicOpen = isClinicOpenDate(today)

  res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
  res.json({
    serving: servingRows[0] || null,
    waiting: waitingRows,
    clinicOpen,
    branch_id: branchId,
    branch_name: branch.name,
  })
})

module.exports = router

const fs = require('fs')
const path = require('path')
const crypto = require('crypto')
const { runTiDBMigration, PROCEDURAL_FILES } = require('./tidbMigrationAdapter')

// Handle mysql CLI DELIMITER directives (including stored-procedure bodies).
// Statements execute serially on a *single* connection. No DROP TABLE and no
// database reset. A migration is recorded only after its last statement succeeds.
function splitMysqlMigration(source) {
  let delimiter = ';', buffer = '', statements = []
  for (const line of source.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    const directive = /^DELIMITER\s+(\S+)$/i.exec(trimmed)
    if (directive) {
      if (buffer.trim()) throw new Error('Malformed migration: incomplete statement before DELIMITER')
      delimiter = directive[1]
      continue
    }
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('--') || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue
    buffer += `${line}\n`
    if (buffer.trimEnd().endsWith(delimiter)) {
      const sql = buffer.trimEnd().slice(0, -delimiter.length).trim()
      if (sql) statements.push(sql)
      buffer = ''
    }
  }
  if (buffer.trim()) throw new Error('Malformed migration: statement has no terminator')
  return statements
}


// When upgrading an already partially migrated database, verify the entire
// foundational ownership contract before recording the migration as applied.
// A single existing table/column is not sufficient evidence.
function requiredFoundationColumns(source) {
  const columns = []
  const pattern = /CALL\s+carait_branch_column\('([^']+)'\s*,\s*'([^']+)'/g
  for (const match of source.matchAll(pattern)) columns.push([match[1], match[2]])
  if (columns.length < 20) throw new Error('Foundation migration ownership catalog is unexpectedly incomplete')
  return columns
}
async function verifyFoundationSchema(db, source) {
  const columns = requiredFoundationColumns(source)
  const tables = [...new Set(['clinic_branches', 'admin_branch_permissions', 'branch_booking_settings', 'branch_stock_transfer_requests', ...columns.map(pair => pair[0])])]
  const placeholders = tables.map(() => '?').join(',')
  const [existingTables] = await db.query(`SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN (${placeholders})`, tables)
  const existingSet = new Set(existingTables.map(row => row.TABLE_NAME || row.table_name))
  const missingTables = tables.filter(table => !existingSet.has(table))
  if (missingTables.length) throw new Error(`Partial foundation schema: missing tables ${missingTables.join(', ')}`)
  const ownershipTables = [...new Set(columns.map(pair => pair[0]))]
  const [existingColumns] = await db.query(`SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN (${ownershipTables.map(() => '?').join(',')})`, ownershipTables)
  const existingPairs = new Set(existingColumns.map(row => `${row.TABLE_NAME || row.table_name}.${row.COLUMN_NAME || row.column_name}`))
  const missingColumns = columns.map(pair => pair.join('.')).filter(key => !existingPairs.has(key))
  if (missingColumns.length) throw new Error(`Partial foundation schema: missing ownership columns ${missingColumns.join(', ')}`)
  return { tables: tables.length, columns: columns.length }
}

// Permit CRLF vs LF and final-newline differences from Windows/Unix checkouts.
// Reject every substantive SQL change to an already applied migration.
const acceptedContentHashes = (source) => {
  const lf = source.replace(/\r\n/g,'\n').replace(/\r/g,'\n')
  const clean = lf.replace(/\n+$/,'')
  const variations = [lf,clean,`${clean}\n`,`${clean}\n\n`]
  const variants = new Set([...variations,...variations.map(v=>v.replace(/\n/g,'\r\n'))])
  return new Set([...variants].map(v=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(v).digest('hex')))
}
const migrationFiles = ['2026-10-09-multi-branch-foundation.sql','2026-10-15-branch-ledgers.sql','2026-10-15-cashier-branch-uniqueness.sql','2026-10-16-paymongo-test-qr.sql','2026-10-17-announcements-campaigns.sql']
async function runBranchMigrations(db) {
  await db.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
    filename VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    content_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    applied_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4`)
  // Hold this row lock on a dedicated connection while DDL executes on worker
  // connections. TiDB and MySQL auto-commit many DDL statements, so the lock
  // transaction must not share a connection with migration work.
  await db.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migration_locks (
    lock_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4`)
  const lockConnection = await db.getConnection()
  let lockTransactionStarted = false
  try {
    await lockConnection.beginTransaction()
    lockTransactionStarted = true
    await lockConnection.query('INSERT IGNORE INTO schema_migration_locks (lock_name) VALUES (?)', ['branch-migrations'])
    await lockConnection.query('SELECT lock_name FROM schema_migration_locks WHERE lock_name=? FOR UPDATE', ['branch-migrations'])
    await runRegisteredBranchMigrations(db)
    await lockConnection.commit()
    lockTransactionStarted = false
  } catch (error) {
    if (lockTransactionStarted) await lockConnection.rollback().catch(() => {})
    throw error
  } finally {
    lockConnection.release()
  }
}

async function runRegisteredBranchMigrations(db) {
  for (const file of migrationFiles) {
    const sql = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'..','db','migrations',file), 'utf8')
    const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(sql).digest('hex')
    const [[saved]] = await db.query('SELECT content_sha256 FROM schema_migrations WHERE filename=?',[file])
    if (saved) {
      if (!acceptedContentHashes(sql).has(saved.content_sha256)) throw new Error(`Previously applied migration changed: ${file}`)
      continue
    }
    // A dump may already include the foundation but no migration registry. The
    // current schema was checked against the source dump before this exception.
    if (file === migrationFiles[0]) {
      const [rows] = await db.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='clinic_branches'")
      if (Number(rows[0]?.n)) {
        await verifyFoundationSchema(db, sql)
        await db.query('INSERT INTO schema_migrations (filename,content_sha256) VALUES (?,?)',[file,hash])
        continue
      }
    }
    const connection = await db.getConnection()
    try {
      // MySQL DDL auto-commits; reruns are made safe by guarded, idempotent SQL.
      const statements = splitMysqlMigration(sql)
      if (String(process.env.DB_PROVIDER || '').toLowerCase() === 'tidb' && PROCEDURAL_FILES.has(file)) {
        // Convert MySQL stored-procedure calls to identical schema guards in JS.
        // The archived SQL + SHA-256 stay unchanged for existing databases.
        await runTiDBMigration(connection, file, statements)
      } else {
        for (const statement of statements) {
          if (/^USE\s+/i.test(statement)) continue // connection already selects DB_NAME
          if (/^DROP\s+TABLE\b/i.test(statement)) throw new Error('Destructive migration blocked')
          await connection.query(statement)
        }
      }
      await connection.query('INSERT INTO schema_migrations (filename,content_sha256) VALUES (?,?)',[file,hash])
    } finally { connection.release() }
  }
}
module.exports = {splitMysqlMigration,requiredFoundationColumns,verifyFoundationSchema,runBranchMigrations,acceptedContentHashes,migrationFiles}

FILE: server/scripts/prepareTidbDump.js

// Produces a non-destructive TiDB import candidate from a local MySQL dump.
// The output is reviewed offline and NEVER applied by this script.
// Default schema-only mode excludes all exported patient/account records.
const fs = require('node:fs')
const path = require('node:path')
function convertDump(input, { includeData = false } = {}) {
  if (includeData && process.env.CARAIT_ACKNOWLEDGE_SENSITIVE_DATA !== 'YES') {
    throw new Error('Including patient/account data requires CARAIT_ACKNOWLEDGE_SENSITIVE_DATA=YES and a private destination.')
  }
  if (!input.includes('-- MySQL dump')) throw new Error('Input is not a recognized MySQL dump.')
  const lines = input.split(/\r?\n/)
  const out = [
    '-- CARAIT TiDB import candidate; REVIEW before use in an EMPTY, DISPOSABLE database.',
    '-- Not an upgrade script. Never run on a database with existing data.',
    `-- Sensitive data included: ${includeData ? 'YES' : 'NO'}.`,
    'SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0;',
  ]
  let inserted = 0, dropped = 0
  for (const line of lines) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('--')) continue
    // Client-specific mysqldump directives, not schema or row data.
    if (/^\/\*!\d+/.test(trimmed) || /^LOCK TABLES\b/i.test(trimmed) || /^UNLOCK TABLES\b/i.test(trimmed)) { dropped++; continue }
    // Export's DROP TABLE would destroy a preexisting TiDB dataset.
    if (/^DROP TABLE(?: IF EXISTS)?\b/i.test(trimmed)) { dropped++; continue }
    if (/^INSERT INTO\b/i.test(trimmed)) {
      if (includeData) out.push(line)
      inserted++
      continue
    }
    // Any other DML, conditional server commands, or procedural SQL must be reviewed.
    if (/^(?:DELETE|TRUNCATE|REPLACE INTO|UPDATE|CREATE PROCEDURE|CREATE TRIGGER|DELIMITER|CALL)\b/i.test(trimmed)) {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported or potentially destructive statement: ${trimmed.slice(0,80)}`)
    }
    out.push(line)
  }
  out.push('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1;', '')
  return { content: out.join('\n'), countDataStatements: inserted, filteredCommands: dropped }
}
if (require.main === module) {
  try {
    const [inputFile, outputFile, flag] = process.argv.slice(2)
    if (!inputFile || !outputFile || (flag && flag !== '--include-data')) {
      throw new Error('Usage: node scripts/prepareTidbDump.js SOURCE.sql OUTPUT.sql [--include-data]')
    }
    if (path.resolve(inputFile) === path.resolve(outputFile)) throw new Error('Output must differ from source.')
    if (fs.existsSync(outputFile)) throw new Error('Output already exists; will not overwrite.')
    const res = convertDump(fs.readFileSync(inputFile, 'utf8'), { includeData: flag === '--include-data' })
    fs.writeFileSync(outputFile, res.content, { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx' })
    console.log(`Wrote TiDB import candidate: ${path.resolve(outputFile)}. Data INSERT statements ${flag ? 'retained' : 'removed'}: ${res.countDataStatements}. Removed MySQL-only directives: ${res.filteredCommands}.`)
  } catch (error) { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1 }
}
module.exports = { convertDump }

// Dependency-free Node regression suite, portable across Windows/macOS/Linux.
const { readdirSync } = require('node:fs')
const { join, resolve } = require('node:path')
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process')
const walk = dir => readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes:true }).flatMap(entry => {
  const file = join(dir, entry.name)
  return entry.isDirectory() ? walk(file) : entry.name.endsWith('.node.cjs') ? [file] : []
})
const files = walk(resolve(__dirname,'../tests')).sort()
if (!files.length) { console.error('No Node regression tests found'); process.exit(1) }
const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', ...files], { stdio:'inherit' })
process.exit(result.status === null ? 1 : result.status)

FILE: server/scripts/tidbMigrationAdapter.js

// Application-managed equivalents for the three historical MySQL stored-procedure
// migrations. The original SQL files and their applied SHA-256 hashes stay intact.
// Only called with DB_PROVIDER=tidb and an unapplied historical migration.
const PROCEDURAL_FILES = new Set([
  '2026-10-09-multi-branch-foundation.sql',
  '2026-10-15-branch-ledgers.sql',
  '2026-10-15-cashier-branch-uniqueness.sql',
])

const id = (value) => {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*$/.test(value)) throw new Error(`Unsafe SQL identifier: ${value}`)
  return `\`${value}\``
}
const argumentsOf = (statement) => {
  const match = /^CALL\s+([A-Za-z_0-9]+)\((.*)\)$/is.exec(statement.trim())
  if (!match) throw new Error(`Unsupported TiDB migration CALL: ${statement.slice(0, 120)}`)
  const parts = []
  let quote = '', current = ''
  for (let i = 0; i < match[2].length; i++) {
    const ch = match[2][i]
    if (quote) {
      if (ch === quote && match[2][i+1] === quote) { current += quote; i++; continue }
      if (ch === quote) { quote = ''; continue }
      current += ch
    } else if (ch === "'" || ch === '"') quote = ch
    else if (ch === ',') { parts.push(current.trim()); current = '' }
    else current += ch
  }
  if (quote) throw new Error('Unterminated quoted argument')
  if (current.trim()) parts.push(current.trim())
  return [match[1], parts]
}
const exists = async (conn, namespace, table, column) => {
  const name = namespace.toUpperCase()
  const field = name === 'COLUMNS' ? 'COLUMN_NAME' : 'INDEX_NAME'
  const [rows] = await conn.query(
    `SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM information_schema.${name} WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME=? AND ${field}=?`,
    [table, column]
  )
  return Number(rows[0]?.n || 0) > 0
}
const tableExists = async (conn, table) => {
  const [rows] = await conn.query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME=?', [table])
  return Number(rows[0]?.n || 0) > 0
}
const addIndex = async (conn, table, name, columns, previous = null, definition = null) => {
  if (!await tableExists(conn, table) || await exists(conn, 'STATISTICS', table, name)) return
  if (!/^[\w\s,()]+$/.test(columns)) throw new Error('Unsafe index column definition')
  const remove = previous && await exists(conn, 'STATISTICS', table, previous) ? `DROP INDEX ${id(previous)}, ` : ''
  const index = definition || `ADD UNIQUE KEY ${id(name)} (${columns.split(',').map(v => id(v.trim())).join(',')})`
  await conn.query(`ALTER TABLE ${id(table)} ${remove}${index}`)
}
async function translateCall(conn, statement) {
  const [name, args] = argumentsOf(statement)
  switch (name) {
    case 'carait_branch_column': {
      const [table, column, definition] = args
      if (await tableExists(conn, table) && !await exists(conn, 'COLUMNS', table, column)) {
        if (!/^[\w(), '\.]+$/.test(definition)) throw new Error('Unsafe column definition')
        await conn.query(`ALTER TABLE ${id(table)} ADD COLUMN ${id(column)} ${definition}`)
      }
      return
    }
    case 'carait_branch_index': {
      const [table, indexName, ddl] = args
      if (await tableExists(conn, table) && !await exists(conn, 'STATISTICS', table, indexName)) {
        // The original DDL is from our immutable migration and must be precisely an index create statement.
        if (!/^CREATE INDEX [\w]+ ON [\w]+ \([\w,\s]+\)$/i.test(ddl)) throw new Error('Unexpected index DDL')
        await conn.query(ddl)
      }
      return
    }
    case 'carait_branch_rekey': {
      const [table, oldIndex, newIndex, columns] = args
      // Recover from partial application even when the old index was already
      // removed before a crash. addIndex skips an existing replacement and
      // drops the old index only when it is still present.
      await addIndex(conn, table, newIndex, columns, oldIndex)
      return
    }
    case 'carait_ensure_branch_ledger_column': {
      const [table] = args
      if (await tableExists(conn, table) && !await exists(conn, 'COLUMNS', table, 'branch_id')) {
        await conn.query(`ALTER TABLE ${id(table)} ADD COLUMN branch_id INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1`)
      }
      return
    }
    case 'carait_ensure_branch_ledger_index': {
      const [table, oldIndex, newIndex, columns] = args
      await addIndex(conn, table, newIndex, columns, oldIndex)
      return
    }
    case 'carait_ensure_barcode_pk': {
      const [rows] = await conn.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='inventory_barcode_sequences' AND CONSTRAINT_NAME='PRIMARY'")
      if (Number(rows[0]?.n) === 1) await conn.query('ALTER TABLE inventory_barcode_sequences DROP PRIMARY KEY, ADD PRIMARY KEY (category,branch_id)')
      return
    }
    case 'carait_cashier_branch_unique': {
      if (await exists(conn, 'STATISTICS', 'cashier_closings', 'uniq_cashier_branch_date')) return
      await addIndex(conn, 'cashier_closings', 'uniq_cashier_branch_date', 'branch_id,cashier_role,staff_id,closing_date', 'uniq_cashier_closing')
      return
    }
    default: throw new Error(`Unrecognized procedure in TiDB migration: ${name}`)
  }
}
async function runTiDBMigration(conn, file, statements) {
  if (!PROCEDURAL_FILES.has(file)) throw new Error(`No TiDB migration adapter for ${file}`)
  for (const statement of statements) {
    if (/^\s*(?:CREATE|DROP)\s+PROCEDURE\b/i.test(statement)) continue
    if (/^\s*USE\s+/i.test(statement)) continue
    if (/^\s*CALL\s+/i.test(statement)) { await translateCall(conn, statement); continue }
    if (/^\s*DROP\s+TABLE\b/i.test(statement)) throw new Error('Destructive migration blocked')
    await conn.query(statement)
  }
}
module.exports = { runTiDBMigration, PROCEDURAL_FILES, argumentsOf, translateCall }

// Read-only SQL verification for the same 20 statements executed by branch Reports.
// EXPLAIN catches missing/ambiguous columns even when all clinic tables are empty.
const fs = require('node:fs')
const path = require('node:path')
const vm = require('node:vm')

const collectBranchReportQueries = async () => {
  const calls = []
  const fakeDb = {
    query: async (sql, params = []) => {
      calls.push({ sql, params })
      if (sql.includes('SELECT report_footer')) return [[{ report_footer: 'Clinic' }]]
      return [[]]
    },
  }
  const mocks = {
    '../db/connect': fakeDb,
    '../utils/reportRange': { resolveReportRange: () => ({ startDate: '2026-04-15', endDate: '2026-10-15' }) },
    '../utils/date': { getTodayDateOnly: () => '2026-10-15', addDaysDateOnly: () => '2026-11-14' },
    '../utils/audit': { writeAuditLog: async () => {} },
  }
  const source = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '../routers/branchReports.js'), 'utf8')
  const fakeModule = { exports: {} }
  const factory = vm.runInNewContext(`(function(require,module,exports){${source}\n})`, {}, { filename: 'branchReports.js' })
  factory(name => {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(mocks, name)) return mocks[name]
    throw new Error(`Unexpected branch report import: ${name}`)
  }, fakeModule, fakeModule.exports)
  await fakeModule.exports.readBranchReport(
    { branchId: 1, branch: { name: 'Test Branch' }, query: {} },
    { json: () => {} },
  )
  if (calls.length !== 20) {
    throw new Error(`Expected 20 branch Reports queries, captured ${calls.length}. Review the verifier when changing report queries.`)
  }
  for (const [index, call] of calls.entries()) {
    if (!/^\s*SELECT\b/i.test(call.sql)) throw new Error(`Unexpected non-read query in Reports: ${index + 1}`)
    if ((call.sql.match(/\?/g) || []).length !== call.params.length) {
      throw new Error(`Wrong SQL placeholder count in Reports query ${index + 1}.`)
    }
  }
  return calls
}

const verifyBranchReportsSql = async db => {
  const queries = await collectBranchReportQueries()
  for (const [index, { sql, params }] of queries.entries()) {
    try {
      await db.query(`EXPLAIN ${sql}`, params)
    } catch (error) {
      const details = error.sqlMessage || error.message
      throw new Error(`Branch Reports query ${index + 1}/${queries.length} failed SQL validation (${error.code || 'SQL_ERROR'}): ${details}`, { cause: error })
    }
  }
  return queries.length
}

if (require.main === module) {
  require('dotenv').config()
  const db = require('../db/connect')
  verifyBranchReportsSql(db)
    .then(count => console.log(`Reports SQL verification passed: ${count} statements validated against MySQL without modifying data.`))
    .catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1 })
    .finally(() => db.end().catch(() => {}))
}

module.exports = { collectBranchReportQueries, verifyBranchReportsSql }

'use strict'
// Portable, dependency-free static route diagnostic. This intentionally fails
// on an unmatched call. Passing it cannot prove branch ownership or DB safety.
const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path')
const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'../..'),read=f=>fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f),'utf8')
const routerFiles=['branches.router.js','branchOperationalReads.js','branchReports.js','branchAudit.js','branchPromotions.js','branchAnnouncements.js','branchSystemWrites.js','branchQueueInventoryWrites.js','branchInventoryItems.js','branchCatalogWrites.js','branchAppointmentWrites.js','branchBillPreviewReads.js','branchGlobalReferenceWrites.js', 'branchPaymentSettingsWrites.js','branchSensitiveWrites.js','branchPaymentActions.js','branchCheckoutDraftWrites.js','branchBillCorrections.js','branchBatchActions.js','branchCashierAndPayment.js','paymongoGateway.js']
const methods=['GET','POST','PUT','PATCH','DELETE']
// Consume one JS template expression ${...}, including nested backtick templates.
function interpolation(str,start){
 let i=start,depth=1,quote=null,escaped=false
 for(;i<str.length;i++){
  const c=str[i]
  if(escaped){escaped=false;continue}
  if(c==='\\'){escaped=true;continue}
  if(quote){if(c===quote)quote=null;else if(quote==='`'&&c==='$'&&str[i+1]==='{'){const nested=interpolation(str,i+2);i=nested.end-1}continue}
  if(c==='\''||c==='"'||c==='`'){quote=c;continue}
  if(c==='{')depth++
  if(c==='}'&&!--depth)return {expr:str.slice(start,i),end:i+1}
 }
 throw new Error('Unbalanced interpolation while scanning a client service URL.')
}
const nestedPaths=expr=>{
 if (/^\s*reconcile\s*\?/.test(expr))return ['']
 if(/^\s*params\s*$/.test(expr))return ['']
 if(/^\s*(?:id|.*Id)\s*\?/.test(expr)||/^\s*[^?]+\?\s*`\//.test(expr)){
  const truePath=/\?\s*`(\/[^`]*)`/.exec(expr)?.[1]||'/:param'
  return ['',truePath.replace(/\$\{[^}]*\}/g,':param')]
 }
 if(/\?\s*`\?/.test(expr)||/\?\s*`\?/.test(expr)||/\?.*\?\$\{/.test(expr))return ['']
 if(/\?\s*`\?/.test(expr)||/^\s*(?:params|date|query|search)\s*\?/.test(expr))return ['']
 if(/^\s*(query|q\.toString\(\)|search\.toString\(\))\s*\?/.test(expr))return ['']
 if(/\?\s*`/.test(expr)&&/\?\$\{/.test(expr))return ['']
 return [':param']
}
function dynamicTemplate(str,at){
 // at points to the start of the first interpolation following a template tick
 const prefix='${getAdminApiBase()}'
 if(!str.startsWith(prefix,at))return null
 let i=at+prefix.length,variants=['']
 for(;i<str.length;){
  if(str[i]==='`')break
  if(str[i]==='$'&&str[i+1]==='{'){
   const {expr,end}=interpolation(str,i+2)
   variants=[...new Set(variants.flatMap(v=>nestedPaths(expr).map(add=>v+add)))];i=end;continue
  }
  variants=variants.map(v=>v+str[i]);i++
 }
 return {paths:[...new Set(variants.map(v=>v.split('?')[0].replace(/\/$/,'')||'/'))],end:i}
}
function splitServices(source){
 const positions=[...source.matchAll(/export\s+(?:const|function)\s+(\w+)/g)]
 return positions.map((m,i)=>({name:m[1],code:source.slice(m.index,positions[i+1]?.index??source.length)}))
}
function serviceCalls(){
 const source=read('client/src/services/admin.service.js'),calls=[]
 for(const {name,code} of splitServices(source)){
  let index=0
  while((index=code.indexOf('${getAdminApiBase()}',index))>=0){
   const url=dynamicTemplate(code,index);if(!url){index+=3;continue}
   // For upload URL properties, POST is the established upload helper contract.
   const before=code.slice(Math.max(0,index-100),index)
   const isUpload=/\b(?:uploadUrl|statusUrl)\s*:\s*`\s*$/.test(before)||/uploadPaymentQrToServer/.test(code.slice(0,index))
   const after=code.slice(url.end+1,url.end+280)
   const m=/^\s*,\s*\{[^}]*?\bmethod\s*:\s*([^,}\n]+)/.exec(after)
   const candidate=m?[...m[1].matchAll(/['"](GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)['"]/g)].map(x=>x[1]):[]
   let wanted=isUpload?['POST']:/\bpostJson\s*\(\s*`\$\{getAdminApiBase\(\)\}/.test(code.slice(Math.max(0,index-20),index+25))?['POST']:candidate.length?[...new Set(candidate)]:['GET']
   // Optional suffix `${id ? `/${id}` : ''}` and conditional method match.
   if(wanted.length===2 && url.paths.length===2){
    for(const p of url.paths)calls.push({method:p.includes(':param')?(wanted.includes('PUT')?'PUT':wanted[0]):(wanted.includes('POST')?'POST':wanted[1]),path:p,functionName:name})
   }else for(const method of wanted)for(const p of url.paths)calls.push({method,path:p,functionName:name})
   index=url.end+1
  }
 }
 return [...new Map(calls.map(c=>[`${c.method} ${c.path} ${c.functionName}`,c])).values()]
}
function patterns(){
 const found=[]
 const add=(method,p,source)=>{
  if(!method||!p||!p.startsWith('/'))return
  const normalized=p.replace(/^\/my\/legacy/,'').replace(/^\/workspace\/:branchId\/legacy/,'').replace(/^\/my(?=\/)/,'').replace(/^\/workspace\/:branchId(?=\/)/,'').replace(/:[\w-]+/g,':param')||'/'
  found.push({method:method.toUpperCase(),path:normalized,source})
 }
 for(const f of routerFiles){
  const source=read('server/routers/'+f)
  for(const m of source.matchAll(/router\.(get|post|put|patch|delete)\(\s*`\$\{prefix\}([^`]+)`/g))add(m[1],m[2],f)
  for(const m of source.matchAll(/router\.(get|post|put|patch|delete)\(\s*`(\/(?:my|workspace)[^`]+)`/g))add(m[1],m[2].replace(/\$\{action\}/g,':param'),f)
  for(const m of source.matchAll(/\breg\(\s*['"](\/[^'"\n]+)['"]\s*,\s*['"](?:[\w_]+)['"]\s*,/g))add('GET',m[1],f)
  for(const m of source.matchAll(/\breg\(\s*['"](get|post|put|patch|delete)['"]\s*,\s*['"](\/[^'"\n]+)['"]/g))add(m[1],m[2],f)
  for(const m of source.matchAll(/\bwithSetup\(\s*['"](\/[^'"\n]+)['"]\s*,\s*['"](get|post|put|patch|delete)['"]/g))add(m[2],m[1],f)
 }
 // The gateway router is mounted on branch-scoped /billing prefixes via router.use.
 // Confirm both the mount and the endpoint exist before counting route coverage.
 const gateway = read('server/routers/paymongoGateway.js')
 const branchMount = read('server/routers/branches.router.js')
 if (branchMount.includes('require(\'./paymongoGateway\').apiRouter') && branchMount.includes('`${prefix}/billing`')) {
  if (gateway.includes("apiRouter.post('/:id/qr-payment'")) add('POST','/billing/:param/qr-payment','paymongoGateway.js')
  if (gateway.includes("apiRouter.get('/:id/qr-payment/status'")) add('GET','/billing/:param/qr-payment/status','paymongoGateway.js')
  if (gateway.includes("apiRouter.post('/:id/qr-payment/:attemptId/resolve'")) add('POST','/billing/:param/qr-payment/:param/resolve','paymongoGateway.js')
 }
 for(const a of ['confirm','cancel','no-show','reschedule'])add('PATCH',`/appointments/:param/${a}`,'branches.router.js')
 return [...new Map(found.map(r=>[`${r.method} ${r.path}`,r])).values()]
}
const match=(pattern,p)=>new RegExp('^'+pattern.replace(/[-/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g,'\\$&').replace(/:param/g,'[^/]+')+'$').test(p)
function analyze(){
 const declared=patterns(),calls=serviceCalls(),missing=calls.filter(c=>!declared.some(r=>r.method===c.method&&match(r.path,c.path)))
 return {scope:'Admin service: Branch Admin and Super Admin workspace static routes only. Staff/Doctor/Patient coverage and runtime ownership require separate tests.',service_calls:calls.length,known_patterns:declared.length,unmatched:missing.length,missing:missing.map(c=>`${c.method} ${c.path} (${c.functionName})`)}
}
const output=analyze()
if(require.main===module){console.log(JSON.stringify(output,null,2));if(output.unmatched)process.exitCode=1}
module.exports={patterns,serviceCalls,analyze,output}

const run = async () => {
  try {
    const { warnings } = validateRuntimeConfig()
    warnings.forEach((warning) => console.warn(`WARNING: ${warning}`))

    await db.query('SELECT 1 AS result')
    const [tableRows] = await db.query(
      `SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ?`,
      [process.env.DB_NAME]
    )
    const tables = new Set(tableRows.map((row) => row.TABLE_NAME))
    const missingTables = REQUIRED_TABLES.filter((name) => !tables.has(name))

    const missingColumns = []
    for (const [table, columns] of Object.entries(REQUIRED_COLUMNS)) {
      if (!tables.has(table)) continue
      const [rows] = await db.query(
        `SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND TABLE_NAME = ?`,
        [process.env.DB_NAME, table]
      )
      const existing = new Set(rows.map((row) => row.COLUMN_NAME))
      for (const column of columns) if (!existing.has(column)) missingColumns.push(`${table}.${column}`)
    }

    if (missingTables.length || missingColumns.length) {
      if (missingTables.length) console.error(`Missing tables: ${missingTables.join(', ')}`)
      if (missingColumns.length) console.error(`Missing columns: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}`)
      throw new Error('Database schema is not deployment-ready. Run `npm run migrate` and verify again.')
    }

    const [criticalColumnRows] = await db.query(
      `SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, NUMERIC_SCALE
       FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
       WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ?
         AND (TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME) IN (
           ('password_resets','role'),
           ('supply_requests','qty_requested'),
           ('supply_requests','request_group_id'),
           ('inventory_logs','movement_type'),
           ('inventory','measurement_value'),
           ('inventory','measurement_unit')
         )`,
      [process.env.DB_NAME]
    )

    const recoveryRole = criticalColumns.get('password_resets.role')
    if (!recoveryRole || recoveryRole.DATA_TYPE !== 'varchar' || Number(recoveryRole.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH || 0) < 20) {
      throw new Error('password_resets.role must be VARCHAR(20+) so Admin recovery is supported. Run `npm run migrate`.')
    }
    const transferGroup = criticalColumns.get('supply_requests.request_group_id')

    const movementType = criticalColumns.get('inventory_logs.movement_type')

      throw new Error('inventory_logs.movement_type must be VARCHAR(80+) for configured movement reason codes. Run `npm run migrate`.')
    }
    const measurementValue = criticalColumns.get('inventory.measurement_value')

    }
    const measurementUnit = criticalColumns.get('inventory.measurement_unit')

    }

'use strict'
// Safe to run on a local CARAIT installation: sends GET requests only.
// It never creates accounts, sends emails, changes payments, or mutates the database.
const base = (process.env.CARAIT_API_BASE || 'http://localhost:3000').replace(/\/$/,'')
const checks = [
  {path:'/api/health',statuses:[200],name:'Express health'},
  {path:'/api/ready',statuses:[200],name:'Database readiness'},
  {path:'/api/news',statuses:[200],name:'Public News & Offers'},
  {path:'/api/branches/accounts/admins',statuses:[401],name:'Admin directory rejects anonymous access'},
  {path:'/api/webhooks/paymongo',statuses:[405],name:'Webhook rejects GET'},
  {path:'/api/_carait_missing_route_test_',statuses:[404],name:'Missing API routes return JSON'},
]
async function main(){
  console.log(`CARAIT read-only preflight: ${base}`)
  let failures=0
  for(const c of checks){
    const controller=new AbortController()
    const timeout=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),5000)
    try{
      const response=await fetch(`${base}${c.path}`,{method:'GET',redirect:'manual',signal:controller.signal})
      const contentType=response.headers.get('content-type')||''
      let parsed
      try{parsed=await response.json()}catch{}
      const ok=c.statuses.includes(response.status)&&contentType.includes('application/json')
      console.log(`${ok?'PASS':'FAIL'} ${c.name}: HTTP ${response.status}, JSON ${contentType.includes('application/json')?'yes':'no'}${!ok&&parsed?.code?`, code ${parsed.code}`:''}`)
      if(!ok)failures++
    }catch(error){console.log(`BLOCKED ${c.name}: ${error.message}`);failures++}
    finally{clearTimeout(timeout)}
  }
  console.log(`Read-only runtime result: ${checks.length-failures}/${checks.length} passed`)
  if(failures)process.exitCode=1
}
main().catch(error=>{console.error(error.message);process.exitCode=1})

FILE: server/scripts/verifySourceGraph.js

const fs = require('fs')
const path = require('path')

const projectRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..')
const serverRoot = path.join(projectRoot, 'server')
const clientRoot = path.join(projectRoot, 'client', 'src')

const SOURCE_EXTENSIONS = ['.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs', '.json', '.css']
const SOURCE_FILE_EXTENSIONS = new Set(['.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs'])
const IGNORED_DIRS = new Set(['node_modules', 'coverage', 'dist', '.git'])

const walk = (root) => {
  const files = []
  const visit = (dir) => {
    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      if (entry.isDirectory() && IGNORED_DIRS.has(entry.name)) continue
      const full = path.join(dir, entry.name)
      if (entry.isDirectory()) visit(full)
      else if (SOURCE_FILE_EXTENSIONS.has(path.extname(entry.name))) files.push(full)
    }
  }
  if (fs.existsSync(root)) visit(root)
  return files
}

// Remove comments before scanning so examples in comments do not become false missing imports.
// Preserve quoted strings because import/require specifiers live inside them.
const stripComments = (source) => {
  let out = ''
  let i = 0
  let state = 'code'
  let quote = ''
  while (i < source.length) {
    const ch = source[i]
    const next = source[i + 1]
    if (state === 'code') {
      if (ch === '/' && next === '/') { state = 'line'; out += '  '; i += 2; continue }
      if (ch === '/' && next === '*') { state = 'block'; out += '  '; i += 2; continue }
      if (ch === '"' || ch === "'" || ch === '`') { state = 'string'; quote = ch; out += ch; i += 1; continue }
      out += ch; i += 1; continue
    }
    if (state === 'line') {
      if (ch === '\n') { state = 'code'; out += '\n' } else out += ' '
      i += 1; continue
    }
    if (state === 'block') {
      if (ch === '*' && next === '/') { state = 'code'; out += '  '; i += 2 }
      else { out += ch === '\n' ? '\n' : ' '; i += 1 }
      continue
    }
    if (state === 'string') {
      out += ch
      if (ch === '\\' && i + 1 < source.length) { out += source[i + 1]; i += 2; continue }
      if (ch === quote) { state = 'code'; quote = '' }
      i += 1
    }
  }
  return out
}

const resolveRelative = (fromFile, specifier) => {
  const base = path.resolve(path.dirname(fromFile), specifier)
  const candidates = [base]
  const ext = path.extname(base)
  if (!SOURCE_EXTENSIONS.includes(ext)) {
    for (const candidateExt of SOURCE_EXTENSIONS) candidates.push(`${base}${candidateExt}`)
    for (const candidateExt of SOURCE_EXTENSIONS) candidates.push(path.join(base, `index${candidateExt}`))
  }
  return candidates.find((candidate) => fs.existsSync(candidate) && fs.statSync(candidate).isFile()) || null
}

const collectSpecifiers = (file, source) => {
  const cleaned = stripComments(source)
  const specs = []
  const patterns = [
    /\brequire\(\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]\s*\)/g,
    /\bimport\s+(?:[^'";]+?\s+from\s+)?['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g,
    /\bexport\s+[^'";]+?\s+from\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g,
    /\bimport\(\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]\s*\)/g,
  ]
  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    let match
    while ((match = pattern.exec(cleaned))) specs.push(match[1])
  }
  return specs.filter((specifier) => specifier.startsWith('.'))
}

const roots = [serverRoot, clientRoot]
const missing = []
let scannedFiles = 0
let relativeImports = 0

for (const root of roots) {
  for (const file of walk(root)) {
    scannedFiles += 1
    const source = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    for (const specifier of collectSpecifiers(file, source)) {
      relativeImports += 1
      if (!resolveRelative(file, specifier)) {
        missing.push({
          file: path.relative(projectRoot, file).replace(/\\/g, '/'),
          specifier,
        })
      }
    }
  }
}

if (missing.length) {
  console.error(`Source graph verification failed: ${missing.length} missing relative module(s).`)
  for (const item of missing) console.error(` - ${item.file} -> ${item.specifier}`)
  process.exitCode = 1
} else {
  console.log(`Source graph verification passed: ${scannedFiles} source files, ${relativeImports} relative imports resolved.`)
}
